title: Probe return
description: Return shape for hektor-bug-discovery dispatches (description prefix probe-<j-slug>:). A confirmed app bug must become either a regression test or a @ScheduledDisable entry with a ticket.

confirmed-bugs.description: Findings that reproduced and are genuine app bugs (not test issues).

regression-tests-added.description: Tests added to lock confirmed bugs that have a fix.

disabled-tickets.description: Ticket IDs for bugs parked behind @ScheduledDisable awaiting a product fix.

findings-ledger.description: Path to docs/hektor/adversarial-findings.md where findings were recorded.
